dossier.scp_unleashed.280.title: Eyes in the Dark
dossier.scp_unleashed.280.caption: Frame recovered from an unlit storage bay. Nothing was in the bay when the lights came on.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-280-1 is not presently contained. Any area where it has been sighted is to be kept brightly lit at all hours, and no lighting there may be switched off without approval.
Personnel who have read this file are not to enter unlit spaces alone, and are to carry a light at all times.
**Do not try to outrun SCP-280-1 in the dark.** Move toward light.
%rProcedures for its recapture are restricted to staff with Level 4 clearance. See Addendum 280-2.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-280 is a phenomenon that follows those who have read this file. Readers begin to see pairs of eyes in unlit places at the edge of their sight. The eyes are pale and watchful. They blink, and they are gone when a light is brought or when the witness comes near.
Witnesses who spend long in the dark report that the eyes come more often, come closer, and come in greater numbers. %rLooking back at them does not help.%r
In time SCP-280-1 shows itself: a tall, thin figure of shadow, its body covered in eyes that blink and look about on their own.

SCP-280-1 moves quickly through darkness and attacks anyone it can reach there. It will not step into bright light, and it shrinks from a lamp turned toward it. Light can wear it away, but it always returns to the dark. Weapons pass through it.

page.title: Addendum 280-1: Witness Log
text: W-1, motor pool, night shift: "Two of them, low down by the tyres. Gone when I lifted the torch."
W-3, archive basement: "Four pairs this time. Closer. I stopped turning round to look."
W-3, twelve days later: %rDATA EXPUNGED%r. The basement lights had been off for six hours.

page.title: Addendum 280-2: Incident 280-04
text: An agent drew SCP-280-1 down a service corridor and into an empty storage bay, then barred the door behind him. When the floodlights in the bay came on, it did not run. It folded itself into a corner and closed its eyes, one at a time.
While it stayed there, no one on site reported a single sighting. %rThe bay lost power nineteen days later.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp280_shade_spaw: SCP-280-1 is a tall, thin figure of shadow covered in pale eyes that blink and wander on their own. It does not occur naturally.
Once the SCP-280 file has been read, eyes begin to appear in unlit places. Those who linger in the dark see more of them, and in time something steps out to meet them.
In darkness it is fast and its touch wounds. It will not follow anyone into a bright place, and a lamp turned toward it drives it back.
Weapons pass straight through it. Light wears it away for a while, but it always comes back. A world holds one SCP-280-1 at a time.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp280.0: Reported only in unlit places, after this file is read.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp280.1: Eyes, in pairs. Gone when a light is brought.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp280.2: Do not stay in the dark.
